description: This file defines the HoverChromeContainerView class, a custom NSView subclass responsible for displaying a content view with an overlay chrome in a macOS application. It manages tracking areas for mouse hover effects, contains nested classes for draggable and resizable handles, and includes UI elements like a close button with associated behaviors.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView
classes.description: A custom container view that includes a content view and an overlay chrome with close and drag handle controls. It manages hover effects and tracking areas.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasDragHandleView
classes.description: A small view that enables dragging of the window when mouse down occurs.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasResizeHandleView
classes.description: A view that provides resizing capability for the window when mouse dragged.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasChromeOverlayView
classes.description: A view that overlays the content, providing close, drag, and resize handles, and managing hit testing to forward mouse events appropriately.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasChromeOverlayView.PassthroughVisualEffectView
classes.description: A visual effect view subclass that passes through hit testing (does not intercept mouse events).

methods.name: updateTrackingAreas
methods.description: Overrides NSView method to update and manage mouse tracking areas for hover effects.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Called when the close button is clicked; executes the onClose closure if provided.
